title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court Concerning the Issue That after a Partnership Organization Acting as a Guarantor Is Dissolved and Publishes a Notice on Its Own for a Limited Period to Clear Claims and Debts, Creditors Have the Right within the Statute of Limitations Period to Require Partners to Bear Guarantee Liability

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply Concerning the Issue of Whether a Creditor Has the Right to Require a Partner to Assume Guarantee Liability Within the Limitation of Action After a Partnership Organization Acting as Guarantor Is Dissolved and Publishes a Notice to Clear Its Creditor's Rights and Debts Within a Specified Period
Fa (Jing) Fu [1988] No. 46

The Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province:

We have received your Request for Instructions No. 2 (Qian Fa [1988] Jing Qing Zi No. 2). Upon study, we reply as follows:

Xingyi County Lianying Huirui Trading Company, as the guarantor of Deng Guoqiang, shall assume joint and several liability for compensation to the Xingyi County Sub-branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China for Deng Guoqiang's failure to pay rent in accordance with the contract. After Huirui Company was dissolved by the administrative authority for industry and commerce, it posted a notice setting a time limit for clearing its creditor's rights and debts, and declared that it would not be liable after the deadline. Such a notice shall have no legal binding force on creditors. The Xingyi County Sub-branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China may, within the limitation of action provided for in the General Principles of the Civil Law, require Huirui Trading Company to assume guarantee liability. Given that Huirui Trading Company was in fact a partnership organization, after its dissolution, the partners shall assume joint and several guarantee liability with their own property.

This reply.

October 18, 1988
